name: Panorama Mall
summary: Panorama Mall is a well-established indoor shopping center in Panorama City offering a diverse mix of retailers, fast food restaurants, and services. Operated by Primestor Development, this community-focused mall serves the San Fernando Valley with convenient shopping and has earned strong ratings from thousands of local visitors.
demographics: Panorama Mall serves a predominantly Hispanic and working-class community in the San Fernando Valley's Panorama City neighborhood. The primary trade area consists of families with moderate incomes, ranging from young parents to multi-generational households seeking value-oriented shopping options. Visitors typically include local residents looking for convenient access to everyday retail needs, services, and dining in an indoor mall environment. The center attracts budget-conscious shoppers who prioritize affordability and practical merchandise over luxury brands.
description: Panorama Mall is a long-standing indoor shopping center located at 8401 Van Nuys Boulevard in Panorama City, California, serving the San Fernando Valley community for decades. Owned and operated by Primestor Development Inc., this regional mall has been a cornerstone of the local retail landscape, providing residents with convenient access to a variety of retailers, fast food restaurants, and essential services under one roof. The mall features an enclosed climate-controlled environment that offers comfortable year-round shopping, with operating hours Monday through Friday from 11 AM to 8 PM, Saturdays from 10 AM to 8 PM, and Sundays from 10 AM to 7 PM. With a strong rating of 4 stars from over 8,000 reviews, Panorama Mall has maintained its relevance in the community by adapting to changing retail trends and continuing to serve as a gathering place for local families. The center offers leasing opportunities including specialty leasing and advertising options, and maintains an active presence with events, sales, and promotions designed to engage the community and drive foot traffic to its diverse tenant mix.
